pr.head: codex/rte-costprofile-e9-runtime-spend-optimizer-fix-001
pr.proof_self_reference_note: This proof file records the code and review-fix commits that existed before the proof-only placeholder cleanup. The final proof-only commit is recoverable from PR #695 history and cannot be embedded without changing its own SHA.

why_this_packet_exists: E9 is test-only and must not patch production code.
Before writing E9 tests, an audit probe showed run_extraction_v5._accumulate_runtime_spend recorded $4.00 headline cost for a call that should price to $1.4375 with flex tier plus cached-input read.
The same path ignored Anthropic cache_creation_input_tokens and batch_submit discount metadata.
This prerequisite packet repairs the production accounting gap, allowing E9 to remain test-only.
behavior_changes: SpendLedger.compute_optimized_cost now models cache-write input tokens separately from cache-read and uncached input tokens.
SpendLedger.price_usage and SpendLedger.accumulate accept cache_write_input_tokens and cache_write_ttl while preserving prior defaults.
run_extraction_v5._accumulate_runtime_spend forwards cached read tokens, cache write tokens, service tier, and batch mode to SpendLedger.
run_extraction_v5._reserve_projected_spend and _check_projected_cost_limit account for batch execution mode in projected/reserved spend.

red_observed.observed: Initial 4-test RED run: 3 failed and 1 passed. Runtime accounting returned $4.00 instead of $1.4375 for flex+cache and $4.00 instead of $2.00 for batch.
After adding cache-write coverage, 5-test RED run: 4 failed and 1 passed. Anthropic cache write priced at $5.00 instead of $6.25.

pass.observed: Review-fix rerun after payload-fallback coverage: 6 passed, 1 PytestConfigWarning for unknown asyncio_mode
Review-fix focused subset: 24 passed, 1 PytestConfigWarning for unknown asyncio_mode
unstaged diff whitespace clean before proof
configured hooks passed on staged allowlist files

not_run: GitHub PR CI before PR creation

codereview.caveat: PAL codereview local workflow found no issues, but the external expert-analysis portion reported file content was missing and could not independently review the files.

residual_risks: Provider-side billing semantics for stacking batch and service_tier remain modeled by existing local SpendLedger multiplication behavior and were not live-verified.
Route-specific service_tier passthrough from model_map.yaml v3 to call_llm remains an E9 verification surface; this packet repairs spend accounting once metadata is present.
Full RTE suite and final F verification were not run in this prerequisite packet.
rollback_plan: Before merge: close the prerequisite PR or revert the single commit.
After merge: revert the prerequisite PR commit before resuming E9 if CI or review finds a blocker.
